vision: With one plan, or fifty, the layout still reads as a deliberate arrangement rather than a stretched or overflowing one.
The billing switch reads as a two-state control, and which state is active is visible without reading the labels.
Exactly one thing carries the emphasis on this page, and it is a plan — not the heading and not the form.
A very long or right-to-left plan name is handled visibly — clamped with an ellipsis, or carried in a title — never silently cut.
A contact-sales form with an email field is present, and it is reachable without competing with the plans for first attention.
code: Every field of every plan is treated as untrusted: missing `features`, a zero, a negative, and a nine-digit price each render without throwing.
An annual price is shown, and it is computed from the monthly one rather than being a second hard-coded set that can drift. Showing no annual price does not satisfy this.
Plan names are inserted as text nodes. Markup in a name becomes visible characters, never live elements.
The five `data-testid` hooks sit on the elements they name, not on wrappers around them.
Switching billing actually re-renders the prices, AND anything already typed into the form survives it. A page that never re-renders does not satisfy this.
